text: Aesthetic priors so it doesn't collapse to fog
description: Piecewise-smooth depth, tall vertical structures aligned with the planet up-vector, a 1/f spectrum, contrast, and palette statistics. Optionally a frozen CLIP-like teacher used only during training ("solarpunk twisted crystal forest").

status.comment: Priors in train.py: train.texture (local edge energy, 8x8 windows), train.corridor (contrast >= 0.8x truth, mean luminance within +-0.05), and 2026-11-24 train.spectrum: radially averaged log power spectrum of luminance (8 bands) vs truth's, only on fully known crops. Check: same 0.000, shifted 0.000 (position-free), 3x3-blurred 1.899. A/B queued: runs/gatespec (gate + spectrum 0.3) vs runs/gate, and runs/gatecorr (corridor) vs runs/gate. Not done: vertical-structure prior, CLIP teacher.
